items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: It was either of those two were always in demand. Ed Garland. Ed Garland. Garland, but there was still another one. I don't remember.

ctx.x: Exactly the same way. The personnel of the band was something that was interesting, too. I remember Ori playing with them. I remember Johnny Dodds. I don't remember Baby Dodds playing with them. If he did, I don't remember it. Bob Foster played with them sometimes. And then what's this other bass down here? It was either of those two were always in demand. Ed Garland. Ed Garland. Garland, but there was still another one. I don't remember. There's so many of them around here. I remember something that none of the…
I never heard that on a record. No.
